title: The World Series returned to Tampa Bay on Monday. At least in theory
text:
The World Series returned to Tampa Bay on Monday. At least in theory 
 Advertisement Viewpoints John Romano Sports Columnist The World Series returned to Tampa Bay on Monday. At least in theory Pitch count | Desperately needing a win in Game 3 after consecutive losses in Milwaukee, the Rays are instead crushed by the Brewers.     .   If you thought it was hard to watch Game 3 of the World Series on Monday night, imagine how difficult it was for Rays manager Kevin Cash. The Brewers crushed Tampa Bay to move within one victory of the franchise's first world championship. [ JEFFEREE WOO | Times ] John Romano is the sports columnist, offering his opinion on all Tampa Bay sports franchises. Reach him at jromano@tampabay.com.
